author: Unknown
date: Set c. 480 BC; written c. 400s–300s BC
audience: Jews living in the Persian empire
overview: Esther, a Jewish woman, becomes queen of Persia. When the official Haman plots to wipe out the Jews, her cousin Mordecai urges her to act: "who knows whether you have not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?" Esther risks her life, the plot is overturned, and the festival of Purim is founded.
storyPlace: Jews living outside the land during the Persian period. God is never named in the book, yet his care is felt throughout.
